statement: Composed public API sequences can violate balance, reservation, or position invariants not covered by existing fuzzing.
representation_change: Model client state as coupled spot/perp/debt/reservation ledgers.
causal_mechanism: Independent mutators may preserve local invariants while breaking global conservation or risk accounting.
assumptions: Public APIs are callable in arbitrary valid order.
predicted_observable: Fuzz or deterministic sequence finds negative free balance, orphan reservation, or conservation delta.
cheap_test: existing fuzz seed and long fuzz run
falsifier: No violation across bounded fuzz plus source trace.

statement: A valid custom implementation of public interfaces reaches a concrete assertion or unsupported code path.
representation_change: Treat public interfaces as adversarial plugin boundaries.
causal_mechanism: Concrete type assumptions survive in automation or lifecycle paths after interface dispatch changed elsewhere.
predicted_observable: panic or corrupted state from interface-compatible wrapper.
falsifier: All interface paths use capability assertions or explicit unsupported errors.

statement: Concurrent gateway, market-data, and scheduler activity has a race or deterministic-causality breach.
representation_change: Treat events as timestamped causality graph rather than goroutine messages.
causal_mechanism: Unlocked publication and asynchronous drains can observe stale/future state or reorder equal-time events.
predicted_observable: race detector output or failing schedule stress test.
falsifier: clean race and repeated deterministic output.
known_failure_modes: scheduled latency couriers remain outside deterministic-phase support

statement: Reservations and automated debt repayment can preserve aggregate balance while violating per-wallet liabilities.
representation_change: Track fee reservations by asset and debt attribution by source wallet.
causal_mechanism: Independent aggregate debits do not update all ownership ledgers.
predicted_observable: Accepted orders overcommit a foreign fee asset or subsequent margin equity hides reborrowed debt.
falsifier: Retained deterministic regressions and invariant checks pass.

statement: One-shot stop channels and scheduled callbacks must not be reused after shutdown.
representation_change: Model shutdown as a terminal state and guard delayed deliveries at execution time.
causal_mechanism: Reconnecting after closure reuses closed channels; callbacks queued before stop outlive their session.
predicted_observable: Double-close panic, post-stop mutation, or stale delivery.

statement: Fixed-seed market outcomes require an ordered simulation ingress, not merely race-free concurrent gateways.
representation_change: Order requests by simulated timestamp, producer ID, and producer sequence before matching; define actor same-time event priority explicitly.
causal_mechanism: Per-client request goroutines and actor select fan-in let host scheduling select price-time priority.
predicted_observable: Equal-seed multi-core runs have different order IDs/trade hashes despite matching random draws.
falsifier: Repeated canonical outcome digests match at normal GOMAXPROCS.

statement: A C++23 or Rust rewrite of matching is the best immediate route to faster, more reliable long simulations.
representation_change: Profile CPU by orchestration, matching, logging, and runtime synchronization before changing language.
causal_mechanism: If matching dominates, native replacement can improve throughput; if causality orchestration dominates, it cannot fix the result validity bottleneck.
predicted_observable: Matcher consumes a material majority of CPU in representative long runs.
falsifier: Profiling shows quiescence/ingress/synchronization dominate and matching is minor.
known_failure_modes: a faster nondeterministic simulation is less useful than a slower reproducible one

statement: Persistent cross-book one-sided liquidity is caused by stale renderer data or nondeterministic actor ordering.
representation_change: Trace inventory, reservations, side-level quotes, and phase-ordered snapshots through a deterministic long run.
causal_mechanism: A partial quote-withdrawal bug can mimic inventory loss; after fixing it, finite unhedged inventory can still deplete under persistent arbitrage flow.
predicted_observable: Post-fix deterministic replay either retains depth or links depletion to a specific inventory/lot constraint.
falsifier: No inventory/quote-side explanation matches deterministic snapshots.
known_failure_modes: a finite unhedged MM is not a general equilibrium baseline

statement: Dynamically listed derivatives are silently absent from existing simulator logs, invalidating derivative flow and option-risk conclusions.
representation_change: Treat every instrument event as venue/symbol-scoped data rather than assuming a static logger set.
causal_mechanism: The exchange looked up an exact symbol logger, but future/option symbols only exist after listing.
predicted_observable: A listed future and option chain have no book/trade/fill records before a dynamic fallback is added.
falsifier: Integration test observes symbol-tagged derivative records across dynamic listing.
known_failure_modes: mixed fallback streams require their symbol envelope during analysis

statement: Predominantly customer option buying creates a short-gamma/short-vega baseline dealer inventory; finite-band delta hedging reduces but does not eliminate delta.
representation_change: Measure signed dealer inventory as Black-76 delta/gamma/vega profiles with recorded model inputs, instead of inferring risk from submitted orders.
causal_mechanism: The dealer sells options to flow and hedges only when its delta gap exceeds a band; static IV leaves vega a local sensitivity.
predicted_observable: With OptionPBuy=0.8, profiles become negative gamma/vega and residual delta stays bounded by pending/banded hedge behavior.
falsifier: Same seeded run lacks the stated sign/path, or per-fill ledger contradicts profile inventory.
known_failure_modes: flat IV is not realised vega PnL

statement: A finite-horizon Avellaneda-Stoikov linear maker improves inventory-tail control over the current linear-skew baseline under identical order flow.
representation_change: Use reservation price F-q*gamma*sigma^2*tau and a risk/fill-decay spread; estimate variance from a documented EWMA of reference-book changes.
causal_mechanism: Inventory shifts reservation price while risk aversion and estimated variance widen quotes; any benefit must survive queue/fill/markout costs.
predicted_observable: Common-random-number runs reduce inventory tails without merely suppressing quote survival or fills.
falsifier: Tail reduction disappears after quote-survival/fill-distance adjustment or marked PnL/markouts worsen without risk benefit.
known_failure_modes: rolling horizon is not a terminal expiry

statement: Cross-venue fragmentation changes risk only when an explicit router bears venue-local inventory and non-atomic leg execution risk.
representation_change: Build three independent deterministic venues before introducing a venue-qualified per-leg order/fill ledger.
causal_mechanism: A common clock alone does not transfer collateral or execute a second leg; any cross-venue effect without an actor is a measurement/identity artefact.
predicted_observable: Independent venue baselines stay separate; a later routed actor reports residual leg exposure and execution cost.
falsifier: A supposed fragmentation result appears with no routed orders or relies on shared client collateral.
known_failure_modes: venue IDs must be preserved through routing

statement: At matched baseline flow, live short-dated option inventory has higher peak gamma while day-scale inventory has higher vega.
representation_change: Retain immutable per-position rows with listing/expiry, then aggregate by remaining maturity rather than original listing label.
causal_mechanism: Black-76 curvature steepens near expiry while vega is larger for a longer time horizon; the dealer's signed inventory determines the sign.
predicted_observable: In the deterministic 48h baseline, TTE <=6h has higher peak absolute gamma and TTE >=24h higher peak absolute vega across all venues.
falsifier: The direction reverses after precision/forward normalization or fails in common-random-number replications.
known_failure_modes: static IV means no realised vega PnL
spot mid is only a forward proxy
actor sample is not exchange-owned terminal state
